items.title: Security update available for Adobe Commerce
items.summary: Adobe released a regularly scheduled security update for Adobe Commerce and Magento Open Source, resolving critical, important, and moderate vulnerabilities that could lead to arbitrary code execution, security feature bypass, and privilege escalation.

items.title: Amasty patches 25 Magento extensions, 1 critical
items.summary: Amasty issued a security release for 25 extensions, with one critical vulnerability that could lead to remote code execution.

items.title: Unauthenticated file upload in Amasty Order Attributes for Magento
items.summary: An unauthenticated arbitrary file upload flaw in Amasty Order Attributes allows attackers to write executable files to a Magento store without logging in, potentially leading to remote code execution.

items.title: Adobe patches critical Magento admin takeover via menu injection
items.summary: A new attack on Adobe Commerce may break the menu bar for admin users, indicating a session theft vulnerability.

items.title: Critical vulnerability in Mirasvit Cache Warmer for Magento (PHP object injection)
items.summary: Sansec discovered an unauthenticated PHP object injection vulnerability in Mirasvit Cache Warmer, a popular Magento extension, allowing remote code execution via a crafted cookie. CISA has added this flaw to its Known Exploited Vulnerabilities catalog due to active exploitation.

items.title: PolyShell: unrestricted file upload in Magento and Adobe Commerce
items.summary: Sansec discovered a critical flaw in Magento's REST API, named PolyShell, that allows unauthenticated attackers to upload executable files by disguising code as an image. Adobe released Magento 2.4.9 containing the fix, but older supported versions remain vulnerable without specific mitigation.
